rules.sentence: Symptoms of osteosarcoma may be present for a significant amount of time, sometimes weeks to months, before patients seek evaluation.
Most commonly, the presenting symptom is bone pain, particularly with activity.
A history of traumatic musculoskeletal injury may or may not be reported.[5]
Pain and swelling at the local site, usually at the growing ends of an extremity or long bones, are the most common presenting symptoms.[25]
